versions.changelog:
Initial release of coil-board-skill.

- Provides programmatic access to Coil's scored, ranked US equity and crypto trend board via x402 protocol and HTTP API.
- Endpoints return market regime, ranked buy candidates, sector/stock/crypto reads, archived data, and more.
- Payment per read in USDC on Base network; instant free API key available for limited use.
- All responses are research-only, never individualized advice or signals.
- Includes detailed usage guidelines and endpoint catalogue in SKILL.md.
